CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.receive_inbound_stock_partial_v1(p_order_id uuid, p_receipts jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_store_id uuid;
  v_supplier_id uuid;
  v_supplier_name text;
  v_order_code text;
  v_product_id uuid;
  v_all_received boolean;
  v_goods_total numeric := 0;
  v_paid_total numeric := 0;
  v_balance numeric := 0;
  v_existing_debt_id uuid;
  v_current_qty numeric := 0;
  v_next_qty numeric := 0;

  -- One canonical business event for THIS receiving execution.
  v_receive_event_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();

  x jsonb;
  r record;
  v_receive_qty numeric;
  v_remaining numeric;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    order_code
  into
    v_org_id,
    v_store_id,
    v_supplier_id,
    v_supplier_name,
    v_order_code
  from public.inbound_stock_orders
  where id = p_order_id;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid inbound order';
  end if;

  if v_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'Order has no store selected';
  end if;

  if v_supplier_id is null then
    raise exception 'Supplier is not linked to this inbound order';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_memberships m
    where m.organization_id = v_org_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.role in ('owner','admin')
      and coalesce(m.is_active,true)=true
  ) then
    raise exception 'Access denied';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.inbound_stock_orders
    where id = p_order_id
      and status = 'RECEIVED'
  ) then
    raise exception 'This inbound order is already fully received';
  end if;

  for x in
    select *
    from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_receipts, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop

    v_receive_qty := coalesce((x->>'qty')::numeric, 0);

    if v_receive_qty <= 0 then
      continue;
    end if;

    select *
    into r
    from public.inbound_stock_items
    where id = (x->>'item_id')::uuid
      and inbound_order_id = p_order_id;

    if r.id is null then
      raise exception 'Invalid inbound item';
    end if;

    v_remaining :=
      coalesce(r.qty_ordered,0) -
      coalesce(r.qty_received,0);

    if v_receive_qty > v_remaining then
      raise exception 'Receive qty cannot exceed remaining qty';
    end if;

    v_product_id := null;

    select p.id
    into v_product_id
    from public.products p
    where p.organization_id = v_org_id
      and p.store_id = v_store_id
      and (
        (
          r.barcode is not null
          and r.barcode <> ''
          and p.barcode = r.barcode
        )
        or
        (
          r.sku is not null
          and r.sku <> ''
          and p.sku = r.sku
        )
      )
    limit 1;

    if v_product_id is null then

      insert into public.products (
        organization_id,
        store_id,
        name,
        sku,
        barcode,
        unit,
        category,
        cost_price,
        selling_price,
        qty_on_hand,
        created_by
      )
      values (
        v_org_id,
        v_store_id,
        coalesce(
          nullif(trim(r.product_name),''),
          'Unnamed Product'
        ),
        nullif(trim(coalesce(r.sku,'')),''),
        nullif(trim(coalesce(r.barcode,'')),''),
        coalesce(
          nullif(trim(coalesce(r.unit,'')),''),
          'pcs'
        ),
        nullif(trim(coalesce(r.category,'')),''),
        coalesce(r.unit_cost,0),
        coalesce(r.proposed_sell_price,0),
        0,
        auth.uid()
      )
      returning id into v_product_id;

    end if;

    insert into public.inventory (
      organization_id,
      store_id,
      product_id,
      qty
    )
    values (
      v_org_id,
      v_store_id,
      v_product_id,
      0
    )
    on conflict (store_id, product_id)
    do nothing;

    select coalesce(i.qty, 0)
    into v_current_qty
    from public.inventory i
    where i.store_id = v_store_id
      and i.product_id = v_product_id
    for update;

    v_next_qty :=
      coalesce(v_current_qty, 0) +
      v_receive_qty;

    update public.inventory
    set
      qty = v_next_qty,
      organization_id = v_org_id,
      updated_at = now()
    where store_id = v_store_id
      and product_id = v_product_id;

    update public.products
    set
      qty_on_hand = v_next_qty,
      unit = coalesce(
        nullif(trim(coalesce(r.unit,'')),''),
        unit
      ),
      category = coalesce(
        nullif(trim(coalesce(r.category,'')),''),
        category
      ),
      cost_price = coalesce(
        nullif(r.unit_cost,0),
        cost_price
      ),
      selling_price = coalesce(
        nullif(r.proposed_sell_price,0),
        selling_price
      ),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_product_id;

    -- ========================================================
    -- IMPORTANT CHANGE:
    -- Every movement produced by THIS receive execution gets
    -- the SAME event_id.
    -- ========================================================

    insert into public.stock_movements (
      organization_id,
      store_id,
      product_id,
      mode,
      amount,
      note,
      created_by,
      supplier_id,
      supplier_name,
      supplier_invoice_no,
      event_id
    )
    values (
      v_org_id,
      v_store_id,
      v_product_id,
      'ADD',
      v_receive_qty,
      'Partial received from inbound order ' ||
        coalesce(v_order_code, p_order_id::text),
      auth.uid(),
      v_supplier_id,
      v_supplier_name,
      v_order_code,
      v_receive_event_id
    );

    update public.inbound_stock_items
    set
      product_id = v_product_id,
      qty_received =
        coalesce(qty_received,0) +
        v_receive_qty,
      updated_at = now()
    where id = r.id;

  end loop;

  select not exists (
    select 1
    from public.inbound_stock_items
    where inbound_order_id = p_order_id
      and coalesce(qty_received,0) <
          coalesce(qty_ordered,0)
  )
  into v_all_received;

  select
    coalesce(total_goods_value,0),
    coalesce(total_paid_amount,0),
    coalesce(total_balance_amount,0)
  into
    v_goods_total,
    v_paid_total,
    v_balance
  from public.inbound_stock_orders
  where id = p_order_id;

  if coalesce(v_balance,0) <= 0 then
    v_balance :=
      greatest(
        coalesce(v_goods_total,0) -
        coalesce(v_paid_total,0),
        0
      );
  end if;

  select id
  into v_existing_debt_id
  from public.business_debts
  where organization_id = v_org_id
    and supplier_id = v_supplier_id
    and note ilike '%' || p_order_id::text || '%'
  limit 1;

  if v_balance > 0
     and v_existing_debt_id is null then

    insert into public.business_debts (
      organization_id,
      store_id,
      debt_scope,
      lender_name,
      lender_phone,
      debt_type,
      principal_amount,
      paid_amount,
      purpose,
      note,
      debt_date,
      status,
      supplier_id,
      created_by
    )
    values (
      v_org_id,
      v_store_id,
      'STORE',
      coalesce(
        nullif(trim(v_supplier_name),''),
        'Supplier'
      ),
      null,
      'SUPPLIER',
      v_balance,
      0,
      'Inbound stock balance: ' ||
        coalesce(v_order_code, p_order_id::text),
      'Auto-created from inbound order. INBOUND_ORDER_ID:' ||
        p_order_id::text,
      current_date,
      'OPEN',
      v_supplier_id,
      auth.uid()
    );

  end if;

  update public.inbound_stock_orders
  set
    status =
      case
        when v_all_received
          then 'RECEIVED'
        else 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED'
      end,

    received_at =
      case
        when v_all_received
          then coalesce(received_at, now())
        else received_at
      end,

    updated_at = now()

  where id = p_order_id;

  return true;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.allocate_field_money_v1(p_store_id uuid, p_membership_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_role text;
  v_wallet_id uuid;
  v_tx_id uuid;
begin
  -- 1. Auth check
  v_actor := auth.uid();
  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if p_amount is null or p_amount <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Amount must be greater than 0';
  end if;

  -- 2. Check actor role (owner/admin)
  select lower(m.role)
  into v_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.user_id = v_actor
    and m.organization_id = (
      select s.organization_id from public.stores s where s.id = p_store_id
    )
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_role not in ('owner','admin') then
    raise exception 'No access: owner/admin only';
  end if;

  -- 3. Get or create wallet
  select w.id
  into v_wallet_id
  from public.field_wallets w
  where w.store_id = p_store_id
    and w.membership_id = p_membership_id
  limit 1;

  if v_wallet_id is null then
    insert into public.field_wallets (
      store_id,
      membership_id,
      balance,
      total_allocated
    )
    values (
      p_store_id,
      p_membership_id,
      0,
      0
    )
    returning id into v_wallet_id;
  end if;

  -- 4. Insert transaction
  insert into public.field_wallet_transactions (
    wallet_id,
    store_id,
    membership_id,
    amount,
    type,
    note,
    created_by
  )
  values (
    v_wallet_id,
    p_store_id,
    p_membership_id,
    p_amount,
    'ALLOCATE',
    p_note,
    v_actor
  )
  returning id into v_tx_id;

  -- 5. Update wallet balance
  update public.field_wallets
  set
    balance = coalesce(balance,0) + p_amount,
    total_allocated = coalesce(total_allocated,0) + p_amount,
    updated_at = now()
  where id = v_wallet_id;

  return v_tx_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.allocate_field_wallet_v1(p_store_id uuid, p_membership_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_wallet_id uuid;
  v_before numeric := 0;
  v_after numeric := 0;
  v_cycle_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if p_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_store_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_membership_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_amount is null or p_amount <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Amount must be greater than zero';
  end if;

  select s.organization_id
    into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id
    and s.store_type = 'FIELD_PROCUREMENT'
    and coalesce(s.is_active, true) = true;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid Field Procurement store';
  end if;

  select m.role
    into v_actor_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.organization_id = v_org_id
    and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_actor_role not in ('owner', 'admin') then
    raise exception 'Only owner/admin can allocate field wallet funds';
  end if;

  select c.id
    into v_cycle_id
  from public.field_cycles c
  where c.store_id = p_store_id
    and c.status = 'OPEN'
  order by c.opened_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_cycle_id is null then
    raise exception 'NO_ACTIVE_FIELD: Open a field cycle before allocating money';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_memberships m
    join public.org_membership_stores ms on ms.membership_id = m.id
    where m.id = p_membership_id
      and m.organization_id = v_org_id
      and ms.store_id = p_store_id
      and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  ) then
    raise exception 'Target member is not assigned to this store';
  end if;

  insert into public.field_wallets (
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    membership_id,
    balance,
    created_by,
    is_active
  )
  values (
    v_org_id,
    p_store_id,
    p_membership_id,
    0,
    auth.uid(),
    true
  )
  on conflict (store_id, membership_id)
  do nothing;

  select w.id, w.balance
    into v_wallet_id, v_before
  from public.field_wallets w
  where w.store_id = p_store_id
    and w.membership_id = p_membership_id
    and w.organization_id = v_org_id
  for update;

  v_after := coalesce(v_before, 0) + p_amount;

  update public.field_wallets
  set
    balance = v_after,
    updated_at = now(),
    is_active = true
  where id = v_wallet_id;

  insert into public.field_wallet_transactions (
    wallet_id,
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    membership_id,
    field_cycle_id,
    type,
    amount,
    balance_before,
    balance_after,
    note,
    created_by
  )
  values (
    v_wallet_id,
    v_org_id,
    p_store_id,
    p_membership_id,
    v_cycle_id,
    'ALLOCATE',
    p_amount,
    coalesce(v_before, 0),
    v_after,
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_note, '')), ''),
    auth.uid()
  );

  return v_wallet_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_active_field_cycle_summary_v1(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(cycle_id uuid, organization_id uuid, store_id uuid, title text, target_amount numeric, total_allocated numeric, field_remaining numeric, total_expenses numeric, target_spent numeric, operational_spent numeric, agent_wallet_balance numeric, status text, opened_at timestamp with time zone, note text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_actor_membership_id uuid;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_cycle_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select s.organization_id
    into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id
    and s.store_type = 'FIELD_PROCUREMENT'
    and coalesce(s.is_active, true) = true;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid Field Procurement store';
  end if;

  select m.id, m.role
    into v_actor_membership_id, v_actor_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.organization_id = v_org_id
    and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_actor_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'Not a member of this organization';
  end if;

  select c.id
    into v_cycle_id
  from public.field_cycles c
  where c.store_id = p_store_id
    and c.status = 'OPEN'
  order by c.opened_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_cycle_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  select
    c.id as cycle_id,
    c.organization_id,
    c.store_id,
    c.title,
    coalesce(c.target_amount, 0)::numeric as target_amount,

    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'ALLOCATE'), 0)::numeric as total_allocated,

    greatest(
      coalesce(c.target_amount, 0)
      - coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'ALLOCATE'), 0),
      0
    )::numeric as field_remaining,

    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'EXPENSE'), 0)::numeric as total_expenses,

    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (
      where t.type = 'EXPENSE'
        and coalesce(t.purpose, '') = 'TARGET'
    ), 0)::numeric as target_spent,

    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (
      where t.type = 'EXPENSE'
        and coalesce(t.purpose, '') = 'OPERATIONAL'
    ), 0)::numeric as operational_spent,

    coalesce((
      select sum(w.balance)
      from public.field_wallets w
      where w.store_id = p_store_id
        and w.organization_id = v_org_id
    ), 0)::numeric as agent_wallet_balance,

    c.status::text,
    c.opened_at,
    c.note
  from public.field_cycles c
  left join public.field_wallet_transactions t
    on t.field_cycle_id = c.id
   and t.store_id = c.store_id
  where c.id = v_cycle_id
    and c.organization_id = v_org_id
    and (
      v_actor_role in ('owner', 'admin')
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.field_wallets w
        where w.store_id = p_store_id
          and w.membership_id = v_actor_membership_id
      )
    )
  group by
    c.id,
    c.organization_id,
    c.store_id,
    c.title,
    c.target_amount,
    c.status,
    c.opened_at,
    c.note;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_active_field_cycle_v1(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(cycle_id uuid, organization_id uuid, store_id uuid, title text, target_amount numeric, status text, opened_at timestamp with time zone, opened_by uuid, note text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    c.id,
    c.organization_id,
    c.store_id,
    c.title,
    c.target_amount,
    c.status,
    c.opened_at,
    c.opened_by,
    c.note
  from public.field_cycles c
  where c.store_id = p_store_id
    and c.status = 'OPEN'
  order by c.opened_at desc
  limit 1;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_purchase_details_v1(p_customer_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(sale_id uuid, purchase_date timestamp with time zone, payment_method text, product_id uuid, product_name text, sku text, qty numeric, unit_price numeric, line_total numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_store_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if p_customer_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_customer_id required';
  end if;

  select cus.store_id
  into v_store_id
  from public.customers as cus
  where cus.id = p_customer_id;

  if v_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'customer not found';
  end if;

  perform public.ensure_my_store_access(v_store_id);

  return query
  select
    sal.id::uuid as sale_id,

    coalesce(
      sal.sold_at,
      sal.created_at
    )::timestamptz as purchase_date,

    upper(
      coalesce(
        sal.payment_method,
        'CASH'
      )
    )::text as payment_method,

    prod.id::uuid as product_id,

    prod.name::text as product_name,

    prod.sku::text as sku,

    si.qty::numeric as qty,

    si.unit_price::numeric as unit_price,

    (
      si.qty * si.unit_price
    )::numeric as line_total

  from public.sales as sal

  join public.sale_items as si
    on si.sale_id = sal.id

  join public.products as prod
    on prod.id = si.product_id

  where sal.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and sal.store_id = v_store_id

  order by
    coalesce(
      sal.sold_at,
      sal.created_at
    ) desc,
    si.created_at asc;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_expense_channel_summary_v1(p_store_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(channel text, amount numeric, count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
begin

  select s.organization_id
  into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Store not found';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_memberships m
    where m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.organization_id = v_org_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'No access';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    case
      when upper(e.payment_method) = 'CASH' then 'CASH'
      when upper(e.payment_method) in (
        'MOBILE',
        'M-PESA',
        'MPESA',
        'TIGOPESA',
        'AIRTELMONEY',
        'HALOPESA'
      ) then 'MOBILE'
      when upper(e.payment_method) in (
        'BANK',
        'BANK_TRANSFER',
        'TRANSFER'
      ) then 'BANK'
      else 'OTHER'
    end as channel,

    sum(e.amount)::numeric as amount,
    count(*)::bigint as count

  from public.expenses e
  where e.store_id = p_store_id
    and e.expense_date >= p_from
    and e.expense_date <= p_to

  group by 1
  order by amount desc;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_expense_channel_summary_v2(p_store_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(channel text, amount numeric, count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_from date;
  v_to_exclusive date;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  perform public.ensure_my_store_access(p_store_id);

  select s.organization_id into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id
  limit 1;

  select lower(m.role) into v_actor_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.organization_id = v_org_id
    and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  v_from := coalesce(p_from, current_date);
  v_to_exclusive := coalesce(p_to, current_date) + 1;

  return query
  select

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_expenses_v2(p_store_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, store_id uuid, category_id uuid, category_name text, amount numeric, note text, payment_method text, expense_date date, created_at timestamp with time zone, created_by uuid, created_by_membership_id uuid, recorded_by_email text, recorded_by_role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_role text;
  v_membership_id uuid;
  v_to_exclusive date;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select s.organization_id
  into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Store not found';
  end if;

  select
    m.id,
    lower(coalesce(m.role, ''))
  into
    v_membership_id,
    v_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and m.organization_id = v_org_id
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'No access';
  end if;

  if v_role = 'staff' then
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_membership_stores ms
      where ms.membership_id = v_membership_id
        and ms.store_id = p_store_id
    ) then
      raise exception 'No access to this store';
    end if;

  elsif v_role not in ('owner', 'admin') then
    raise exception 'No access';
  end if;

  /*
   * p_from na p_to zote ni INCLUSIVE.
   *
   * Mfano:
   * p_from = 2026-08-24
   * p_to   = 2026-08-29
   *
   * internally tunatumia:
   * expense_date >= 2026-08-24
   * expense_date <  2026-08-30
   */
  v_to_exclusive :=
    case
      when p_to is null then null
      else p_to + 1
    end;

  return query
  select
    e.id,
    e.store_id,
    e.category_id,
    coalesce(e.category_name, ec.name)::text as category_name,
    e.amount,
    e.note,
    upper(coalesce(e.payment_method, ''))::text as payment_method,
    e.expense_date,
    e.created_at,
    e.created_by,
    e.created_by_membership_id,
    u.email::text as recorded_by_email,
    lower(coalesce(m.role, ''))::text as recorded_by_role

  from public.expenses e

  left join public.expense_categories ec
    on ec.id = e.category_id

  left join public.org_memberships m
    on m.id = e.created_by_membership_id

  left join auth.users u
    on u.id = coalesce(e.created_by, m.user_id)

  where e.store_id = p_store_id

    and (
      p_from is null
      or e.expense_date >= p_from
    )

    and (
      v_to_exclusive is null
      or e.expense_date < v_to_exclusive
    )

    and (
      v_role = 'owner'

      or (
        v_role = 'staff'
        and (
          e.created_by_membership_id = v_membership_id
          or e.created_by = auth.uid()
        )
      )

      or (
        v_role = 'admin'
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from public.org_memberships om_owner
          where om_owner.organization_id = v_org_id
            and lower(coalesce(om_owner.role, '')) = 'owner'
            and (
              om_owner.id = e.created_by_membership_id
              or om_owner.user_id = e.created_by
            )
        )
      )
    )

  order by
    e.expense_date desc,
    e.created_at desc,
    e.id desc

  limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 1)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
end;
$function$

   and t.field_cycle_id = v_cycle_id
  where w.store_id = p_store_id

    )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_cashier_closing_payment_summary_v1(p_shift_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(v_cash_total numeric, v_mobile_total numeric, v_bank_total numeric, v_credit_collected_total numeric, v_grand_paid_total numeric, v_total_sales numeric, v_total_balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_shift record;
  v_my_membership_id uuid;
  v_my_role text;
  v_effective_from timestamptz;
  v_effective_to timestamptz;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if p_shift_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_shift_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null then
    raise exception 'p_from and p_to are required';
  end if;

  if p_to < p_from then
    raise exception 'Invalid range';
  end if;

  select
    cs.id,
    cs.organization_id,
    cs.store_id,
    cs.membership_id,
    cs.opened_at,
    cs.closed_at,
    cs.status
  into v_shift
  from public.cashier_shifts cs
  where cs.id = p_shift_id
  limit 1;

  if v_shift.id is null then
    raise exception 'Shift not found';
  end if;

  perform public.ensure_my_store_access(v_shift.store_id);

  select
    m.id,
    m.role
  into
    v_my_membership_id,
    v_my_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and m.organization_id = v_shift.organization_id
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_my_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'No org membership';
  end if;

  if v_my_role <> 'cashier' then
    raise exception 'Only cashier can use cashier closing summary';
  end if;

  if v_my_membership_id <> v_shift.membership_id then
    raise exception 'You can only view your own cashier closing summary';
  end if;

  -- STRICT SHIFT WINDOW
  v_effective_from := greatest(p_from, v_shift.opened_at);
  v_effective_to := least(p_to, coalesce(v_shift.closed_at, p_to));

  if v_effective_to < v_effective_from then
    return query
    select
      0::numeric as v_cash_total,
      0::numeric as v_mobile_total,
      0::numeric as v_bank_total,
      0::numeric as v_credit_collected_total,
      0::numeric as v_grand_paid_total,
      0::numeric as v_total_sales,
      0::numeric as v_total_balance;
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with sales_base as (
    select
      s.id as sale_id,
      upper(coalesce(s.payment_method, 'CASH')) as sale_payment_method,
      coalesce(s.grand_total, s.total_amount, 0) as sale_total_amount,
      coalesce(s.paid_amount, s.amount_paid, 0) as sale_paid_amount,
      coalesce(s.balance_amount, s.balance_due, 0) as sale_balance_amount
    from public.sales s
    where s.store_id = v_shift.store_id
      and s.cashier_shift_id = v_shift.id
      and s.sold_at >= v_effective_from
      and s.sold_at <= v_effective_to
      and coalesce(s.status, 'COMPLETED') = 'COMPLETED'
  ),
  payment_totals as (
    select
      sp.sale_id,
      upper(coalesce(sp.payment_method, 'CASH')) as payment_method,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(sp.payment_channel, '')), '') as payment_channel,
      coalesce(sum(sp.paid_amount), 0) as paid_amount
    from public.sale_payments sp
    inner join sales_base sb
      on sb.sale_id = sp.sale_id
    where sp.store_id = v_shift.store_id
    group by
      sp.sale_id,
      upper(coalesce(sp.payment_method, 'CASH')),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(sp.payment_channel, '')), '')
  ),
  merged as (
    select
      sb.sale_id,
      sb.sale_total_amount,
      sb.sale_balance_amount,
      coalesce(pt.payment_method, sb.sale_payment_method) as resolved_payment_method,
      pt.payment_channel,
      coalesce(pt.paid_amount, sb.sale_paid_amount, 0) as resolved_paid_amount
    from sales_base sb
    left join payment_totals pt
      on pt.sale_id = sb.sale_id
  ),
  paid_breakdown as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(case when m.resolved_payment_method = 'CASH' then m.resolved_paid_amount else 0 end), 0) as v_cash_total,
      coalesce(sum(case when m.resolved_payment_method = 'MOBILE' then m.resolved_paid_amount else 0 end), 0) as v_mobile_total,
      coalesce(sum(case when m.resolved_payment_method = 'BANK' then m.resolved_paid_amount else 0 end), 0) as v_bank_total,
      coalesce(sum(case when m.resolved_payment_method = 'CREDIT' then m.resolved_paid_amount else 0 end), 0) as v_credit_collected_total,
      coalesce(sum(m.resolved_paid_amount), 0) as v_grand_paid_total
    from merged m
  ),
  sales_totals as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(sb.sale_total_amount), 0) as v_total_sales,
      coalesce(sum(sb.sale_balance_amount), 0) as v_total_balance
    from sales_base sb
  )
  select
    pb.v_cash_total,
    pb.v_mobile_total,
    pb.v_bank_total,
    pb.v_credit_collected_total,
    pb.v_grand_paid_total,
    st.v_total_sales,
    st.v_total_balance
  from paid_breakdown pb
  cross join sales_totals st;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(sale_id uuid, sold_at timestamp with time zone, status text, total_qty bigint, total_amount numeric, payment_method text, payment_channel text, paid_amount numeric, balance_amount numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_shift record;
  v_my_membership_id uuid;
  v_my_role text;
  v_effective_from timestamptz;
  v_effective_to timestamptz;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if p_shift_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_shift_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null then
    raise exception 'p_from and p_to are required';
  end if;

  if p_to < p_from then
    raise exception 'Invalid range';
  end if;

  select
    cs.id,
    cs.organization_id,
    cs.store_id,
    cs.membership_id,
    cs.opened_at,
    cs.closed_at,
    cs.status
  into v_shift
  from public.cashier_shifts cs
  where cs.id = p_shift_id
  limit 1;

  if v_shift.id is null then
    raise exception 'Shift not found';
  end if;

  perform public.ensure_my_store_access(v_shift.store_id);

  select
    m.id,
    m.role
  into
    v_my_membership_id,
    v_my_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and m.organization_id = v_shift.organization_id
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_my_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'No org membership';
  end if;

  if v_my_role <> 'cashier' then
    raise exception 'Only cashier can use cashier closing sales';
  end if;

  if v_my_membership_id <> v_shift.membership_id then
    raise exception 'You can only view your own cashier closing sales';
  end if;

  -- STRICT SHIFT WINDOW
  v_effective_from := greatest(p_from, v_shift.opened_at);
  v_effective_to := least(p_to, coalesce(v_shift.closed_at, p_to));

  if v_effective_to < v_effective_from then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with item_totals as (
    select
      si.sale_id,
      coalesce(sum(si.qty), 0)::bigint as total_qty,
      coalesce(sum(si.line_total), 0) as items_total
    from public.sale_items si
    group by si.sale_id
  ),
  payment_pick as (
    select distinct on (sp.sale_id)
      sp.sale_id,
      upper(coalesce(sp.payment_method, 'CASH')) as payment_method,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(sp.payment_channel, '')), '') as payment_channel,
      coalesce(sp.paid_amount, 0) as paid_amount
    from public.sale_payments sp
    where sp.store_id = v_shift.store_id
    order by sp.sale_id, sp.created_at desc, sp.id desc
  )
  select
    s.id as sale_id,
    s.sold_at,
    coalesce(s.status, 'COMPLETED') as status,
    coalesce(it.total_qty, 0)::bigint as total_qty,
    coalesce(s.grand_total, s.total_amount, it.items_total, 0) as total_amount,
    upper(
      coalesce(
        pp.payment_method,
        s.payment_method,
        'CASH'
      )
    ) as payment_method,
    pp.payment_channel as payment_channel,
    coalesce(pp.paid_amount, s.paid_amount, s.amount_paid, 0) as paid_amount,
    coalesce(s.balance_amount, s.balance_due, 0) as balance_amount
  from public.sales s
  left join item_totals it
    on it.sale_id = s.id
  left join payment_pick pp
    on pp.sale_id = s.id
  where s.store_id = v_shift.store_id
    and s.cashier_shift_id = v_shift.id
    and s.sold_at >= v_effective_from
    and s.sold_at <= v_effective_to
    and coalesce(s.status, 'COMPLETED') = 'COMPLETED'
  order by s.sold_at desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_stock_in_items_v1(p_org_id uuid, p_store_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, product_id uuid, product_name text, store_id uuid, qty numeric, unit_cost numeric, total_value numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone, source text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    sm.id,
    sm.product_id,
    coalesce(p.name, 'Unknown Product')::text as product_name,
    sm.store_id,
    coalesce(sm.amount, 0)::numeric as qty,
    coalesce(nullif(p.cost, 0), p.cost_price, 0)::numeric as unit_cost,
    (
      coalesce(sm.amount, 0)::numeric
      * coalesce(nullif(p.cost, 0), p.cost_price, 0)::numeric
    ) as total_value,
    sm.created_at,
    'stock_movements'::text as source
  from public.stock_movements sm
  left join public.products p on p.id = sm.product_id
  where sm.organization_id = p_org_id
    and sm.store_id = p_store_id
    and sm.created_at >= p_date_from::timestamptz
    and sm.created_at < (p_date_to + 1)::timestamptz
    and coalesce(sm.amount, 0) > 0
    and upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) in (
      'ADD',
      'IN',
      'STOCK_IN',
      'RECEIVE',
      'RECEIVED',
      'PURCHASE',
      'INBOUND'
    )
  order by sm.created_at desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_stock_in_items_v2(p_org_id uuid, p_store_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date, p_include_transfer_in boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, product_id uuid, product_name text, store_id uuid, qty numeric, unit_cost numeric, total_value numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone, source text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

  -- ==========================================================
  -- A. GENUINE STOCK IN
  -- Existing stock_movements source
  -- ==========================================================

  select
    sm.id,
    sm.product_id,
    coalesce(p.name, 'Unknown Product')::text as product_name,
    sm.store_id,

    coalesce(sm.amount, 0)::numeric as qty,

    coalesce(
      nullif(p.cost, 0),
      p.cost_price,
      0
    )::numeric as unit_cost,

    (
      coalesce(sm.amount, 0)::numeric
      *
      coalesce(
        nullif(p.cost, 0),
        p.cost_price,
        0
      )::numeric
    ) as total_value,

    sm.created_at,

    'stock_movements'::text as source

  from public.stock_movements sm

  left join public.products p
    on p.id = sm.product_id

  where sm.organization_id = p_org_id
    and sm.store_id = p_store_id

    and sm.created_at >= p_date_from::timestamptz
    and sm.created_at < (p_date_to + 1)::timestamptz

    and coalesce(sm.amount, 0) > 0

    and upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) in (
      'ADD',
      'IN',
      'STOCK_IN',
      'RECEIVE',
      'RECEIVED',
      'PURCHASE',
      'INBOUND'
    )

    -- Restoring stock after deleting/voiding a sale
    -- is NOT new incoming stock.
    and upper(coalesce(sm.note, ''))
        not like 'OWNER_SALE_DELETE_RESTORE:%'


  union all


  -- ==========================================================
  -- B. INTERNAL STORE TRANSFER IN
  --
  -- transfer_stock_batch_v1 writes:
  -- mode   = TRANSFER
  -- delta  > 0 on destination store
  -- reason = TRANSFER
  -- note   contains FROM=<source store>
  -- ==========================================================

  select
    im.id,
    im.product_id,
    coalesce(p.name, 'Unknown Product')::text as product_name,
    im.store_id,

    coalesce(im.delta, im.amount, 0)::numeric as qty,

    coalesce(
      nullif(p.cost, 0),
      p.cost_price,
      0
    )::numeric as unit_cost,

    (
      coalesce(im.delta, im.amount, 0)::numeric
      *
      coalesce(
        nullif(p.cost, 0),
        p.cost_price,
        0
      )::numeric
    ) as total_value,

    im.created_at,

    'TRANSFER_IN'::text as source

  from public.inventory_movements im

  left join public.products p
    on p.id = im.product_id

  where coalesce(p_include_transfer_in, false) = true

    and im.organization_id = p_org_id
    and im.store_id = p_store_id

    and im.created_at >= p_date_from::timestamptz
    and im.created_at < (p_date_to + 1)::timestamptz

    and upper(coalesce(im.mode, '')) = 'TRANSFER'
    and upper(coalesce(im.reason, '')) = 'TRANSFER'

    -- Destination side only.
    and coalesce(im.delta, 0) > 0

  order by created_at desc;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_stock_in_value_v1(p_org_id uuid, p_store_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_membership_id uuid;
  v_role text;
  v_value numeric;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select membership_id, role
    into v_membership_id, v_role
  from public._resolve_my_membership_in_org(p_org_id);

  if v_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'Not a member of this organization';
  end if;

  if v_role = 'staff' and p_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'Staff must query by store';
  end if;

  if p_store_id is not null then
    perform public._require_store_access_in_org(p_org_id, p_store_id);
  end if;

  if p_date_from is null or p_date_to is null then
    raise exception 'date_from and date_to are required';
  end if;

  if p_date_from > p_date_to then
    raise exception 'date_from cannot be after date_to';
  end if;

  with positive_inventory_movements as (
    select
      m.store_id,
      m.product_id,
      coalesce(m.delta, 0)::numeric as qty_in
    from public.inventory_movements m
    where m.organization_id = p_org_id
      and coalesce(m.delta, 0) > 0
      and (p_store_id is null or m.store_id = p_store_id)
      and (m.created_at::date between p_date_from and p_date_to)
  ),
  positive_stock_movements as (
    select
      sm.store_id,
      sm.product_id,
      case
        when upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) in ('ADD', 'IN') then coalesce(sm.amount, 0)::numeric
        else 0::numeric
      end as qty_in
    from public.stock_movements sm
    where sm.organization_id = p_org_id
      and upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) in ('ADD', 'IN')
      and coalesce(sm.amount, 0) > 0
      and (p_store_id is null or sm.store_id = p_store_id)
      and (sm.created_at::date between p_date_from and p_date_to)
  ),
  all_positive_moves as (
    select store_id, product_id, qty_in
    from positive_inventory_movements

    union all

    select sm.store_id, sm.product_id, sm.qty_in
    from positive_stock_movements sm
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from positive_inventory_movements im
      where im.store_id = sm.store_id
        and im.product_id = sm.product_id
        and im.qty_in = sm.qty_in
    )
  )
  select coalesce(
           sum(
             apm.qty_in * coalesce(p.cost, p.cost_price, 0)
           ),
           0
         )::numeric
    into v_value
  from all_positive_moves apm
  join public.products p
    on p.id = apm.product_id
  where p.organization_id = p_org_id;

  return coalesce(v_value, 0)::numeric;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_stock_intelligence_v1(p_org_id uuid, p_store_id uuid, p_scope text, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, product_id uuid, product_name text, sku text, category text, unit text, store_id uuid, qty_sold numeric, sales_count integer, stock_on_hand numeric, low_stock_threshold numeric, stock_status text, activity_score numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    si.product_id,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(si.qty, 0))::numeric AS qty_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::int AS sales_count
  FROM public.sale_items si
  JOIN public.sales s
    ON s.id = si.sale_id
  WHERE
    s.organization_id = p_org_id
    AND s.created_at BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
    AND (
      (
        UPPER(COALESCE(p_scope, 'ALL')) = 'STORE'
        AND s.store_id = p_store_id
      )
      OR
      UPPER(COALESCE(p_scope, 'ALL')) = 'ALL'
    )
  GROUP BY
    si.product_id,
    s.store_id
),

inventory_data AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    i.store_id,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(i.qty, 0) - COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0),
      0
    )::numeric AS stock_on_hand,
    COALESCE(i.low_stock_threshold, 0)::numeric
      AS low_stock_threshold
  FROM public.inventory i
  WHERE
    i.organization_id = p_org_id
    AND (
      (
        UPPER(COALESCE(p_scope, 'ALL')) = 'STORE'
        AND i.store_id = p_store_id
      )
      OR
      UPPER(COALESCE(p_scope, 'ALL')) = 'ALL'
    )
),

product_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    p.sku,
    p.category,
    p.unit
  FROM public.products p
  WHERE p.organization_id = p_org_id
),

product_store_keys AS (
  SELECT product_id, store_id
  FROM sales_data

  UNION

  SELECT product_id, store_id
  FROM inventory_data
),

merged AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.sku,
    p.category,
    p.unit,
    k.store_id,

    COALESCE(s.qty_sold, 0)::numeric AS qty_sold,
    COALESCE(s.sales_count, 0)::int AS sales_count,

    COALESCE(i.stock_on_hand, 0)::numeric
      AS stock_on_hand,

    COALESCE(i.low_stock_threshold, 0)::numeric
      AS low_stock_threshold,

    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(i.stock_on_hand, 0) <= 0
        THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK'

      WHEN COALESCE(i.low_stock_threshold, 0) > 0
       AND COALESCE(i.stock_on_hand, 0)
           <= COALESCE(i.low_stock_threshold, 0)
        THEN 'LOW_STOCK'

      ELSE 'OK'
    END AS stock_status,

    (
      COALESCE(s.qty_sold, 0)
      + (COALESCE(s.sales_count, 0) * 0.5)
    )::numeric AS activity_score

  FROM product_store_keys k

  JOIN product_base p
    ON p.id = k.product_id

  LEFT JOIN sales_data s
    ON s.product_id = k.product_id
   AND s.store_id = k.store_id

  LEFT JOIN inventory_data i
    ON i.product_id = k.product_id
   AND i.store_id = k.store_id
),

classified AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN qty_sold >= 20
        THEN 'FAST_MOVING'

      WHEN qty_sold > 0
        THEN 'SLOW_MOVING'

      ELSE 'DEAD_STOCK'
    END AS bucket,

    product_id,
    product_name,
    sku,
    category,
    unit,
    store_id,
    qty_sold,
    sales_count,
    stock_on_hand,
    low_stock_threshold,
    stock_status,
    activity_score

  FROM merged
),

movement_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.bucket
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN c.bucket = 'DEAD_STOCK'
            THEN c.stock_on_hand
          ELSE c.activity_score
        END DESC,
        c.product_name ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM classified c
),

movement_rows AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    sku,
    category,
    unit,
    store_id,
    qty_sold,
    sales_count,
    stock_on_hand,
    low_stock_threshold,
    stock_status,
    activity_score
  FROM movement_ranked
  WHERE rn <= GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 10), 1)
),

risk_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    'LOW_STOCK'::text AS bucket,
    c.product_id,
    c.product_name,
    c.sku,
    c.category,
    c.unit,
    c.store_id,
    c.qty_sold,
    c.sales_count,
    c.stock_on_hand,
    c.low_stock_threshold,
    c.stock_status,
    c.activity_score,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN c.stock_status = 'OUT_OF_STOCK' THEN 0
          ELSE 1
        END,
        c.stock_on_hand ASC,
        c.activity_score DESC,
        c.product_name ASC
    ) AS rn

  FROM classified c
  WHERE c.stock_status IN (
    'LOW_STOCK',
    'OUT_OF_STOCK'
  )
),

risk_rows AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    sku,
    category,
    unit,
    store_id,
    qty_sold,
    sales_count,
    stock_on_hand,
    low_stock_threshold,
    stock_status,
    activity_score
  FROM risk_ranked
  WHERE rn <= GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 10), 1)
)

SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM movement_rows

  UNION ALL

  SELECT * FROM risk_rows
) final_rows

ORDER BY
  CASE bucket
    WHEN 'FAST_MOVING' THEN 1
    WHEN 'SLOW_MOVING' THEN 2
    WHEN 'DEAD_STOCK' THEN 3
    WHEN 'LOW_STOCK' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END,
  activity_score DESC,
  product_name ASC;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_stock_intelligence_v1(p_store_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id uuid, product_name text, sku text, qty_sold numeric, revenue numeric, stock_on_hand numeric, low_stock_threshold numeric, stock_status text, bucket text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    si.product_id,
    SUM(si.qty)::numeric AS qty_sold,
    SUM(si.line_total)::numeric AS revenue
  FROM sale_items si
  JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
  WHERE
    s.store_id = p_store_id
    AND s.created_at >= p_from
    AND s.created_at <= p_to
  GROUP BY si.product_id
),

inventory_data AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    (i.qty - COALESCE(i.reserved_qty,0))::numeric AS stock_on_hand,
    COALESCE(i.low_stock_threshold,0)::numeric AS low_stock_threshold
  FROM inventory i
  WHERE i.store_id = p_store_id
)

SELECT
  p.id AS product_id,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.sku,

  COALESCE(s.qty_sold,0) AS qty_sold,
  COALESCE(s.revenue,0) AS revenue,

  COALESCE(inv.stock_on_hand,0) AS stock_on_hand,
  COALESCE(inv.low_stock_threshold,0) AS low_stock_threshold,

  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(inv.stock_on_hand,0) <= COALESCE(inv.low_stock_threshold,0)
         AND COALESCE(inv.stock_on_hand,0) > 0
      THEN 'LOW_STOCK'
    WHEN COALESCE(inv.stock_on_hand,0) <= 0
      THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK'
    ELSE 'OK'
  END AS stock_status,

  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s.qty_sold,0) >= 20 THEN 'FAST_MOVING'
    WHEN COALESCE(s.qty_sold,0) BETWEEN 1 AND 19 THEN 'SLOW_MOVING'
    ELSE 'DEAD_STOCK'
  END AS bucket

FROM products p
LEFT JOIN sales_data s
  ON s.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN inventory_data inv
  ON inv.product_id = p.id

ORDER BY qty_sold DESC;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_supplier_debt_history_v1(p_supplier_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(debt_id uuid, organization_id uuid, store_id uuid, store_name text, lender_name text, principal_amount numeric, paid_amount numeric, balance_amount numeric, purpose text, note text, debt_date date, due_date date, status text, is_overdue boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    d.id,
    d.organization_id,
    d.store_id,
    coalesce(s.name, 'Organization')::text as store_name,
    d.lender_name,
    d.principal_amount,
    d.paid_amount,
    greatest(d.principal_amount - d.paid_amount, 0)::numeric as balance_amount,
    d.purpose,
    d.note,
    d.debt_date,
    d.due_date,
    d.status,
    (
      d.due_date is not null
      and d.due_date < current_date
      and d.status not in ('PAID', 'CANCELLED')
    ) as is_overdue,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at
  from public.business_debts d
  left join public.stores s on s.id = d.store_id
  where d.supplier_id = p_supplier_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_memberships om
      where om.organization_id = d.organization_id
        and om.user_id = auth.uid()
        and coalesce(om.is_active, true) = true
    )
  order by d.created_at desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_supplier_stock_history_v1(p_supplier_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(movement_id uuid, supplier_id uuid, supplier_name text, supplier_invoice_no text, organization_id uuid, store_id uuid, store_name text, product_id uuid, product_name text, sku text, mode text, amount numeric, note text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    sm.id as movement_id,
    sm.supplier_id,
    coalesce(sm.supplier_name, s.name)::text as supplier_name,
    sm.supplier_invoice_no,
    sm.organization_id,
    sm.store_id,
    st.name as store_name,
    sm.product_id,
    p.name as product_name,
    p.sku,
    sm.mode,
    sm.amount,
    sm.note,
    sm.created_at
  from public.stock_movements sm
  left join public.suppliers s on s.id = sm.supplier_id
  left join public.products p on p.id = sm.product_id
  left join public.stores st on st.id = sm.store_id
  where sm.supplier_id = p_supplier_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_memberships om
      where om.organization_id = sm.organization_id
        and om.user_id = auth.uid()
        and coalesce(om.is_active, true) = true
    )

  union all

  select
    i.id as movement_id,
    o.supplier_id,
    coalesce(o.supplier_name, s.name)::text as supplier_name,
    coalesce(o.invoice_number, o.order_code)::text as supplier_invoice_no,
    i.organization_id,
    o.store_id,
    st.name as store_name,
    i.product_id,
    i.product_name,
    i.sku,
    'INBOUND'::text as mode,
    i.qty_ordered as amount,
    coalesce(i.note, 'Inbound stock order ' || coalesce(o.order_code, o.id::text))::text as note,
    i.created_at
  from public.inbound_stock_items i
  join public.inbound_stock_orders o on o.id = i.inbound_order_id
  left join public.suppliers s on s.id = o.supplier_id
  left join public.stores st on st.id = o.store_id
  where o.supplier_id = p_supplier_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_memberships om
      where om.organization_id = i.organization_id
        and om.user_id = auth.uid()
        and coalesce(om.is_active, true) = true
    )

  order by created_at desc;
$function$
